claim: In Table 14 (Standard workflow – nursing), the Triage row and Complex case - illness column reports a clinician-consensus median time of 5 minutes, IQR 4–7 minutes, n=62 respondents. The cell has no adjustment asterisk. The report says adjusted entries are marked and that the other two triage categories remained unchanged after the nursing expert-panel adjustment; therefore this complex-illness cell is the unchanged Delphi consensus estimate. It is a consensus estimate, not observed ED service-time data, and does not establish a generic default or duration distribution.
